tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// dbang bskur ba dngos bzhugs// ༄༅// de nas yon gyi bdag pos maṇ+ḍal phul la/ me tog bzung nas 'di skad ces/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ba re/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rig pa'i dbang bskur ba rdo rje'i cho ga chen po'i phyag rgyas btab pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ a dhiṣ+ṭhi te badz+ra swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog dang spos thogs la/ 'di la dbang bskur du gsol zhes 'don pa bsgyur la/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas spyi bor bum pa bzhag la 'di skad ces/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dhar+m+mā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ na mo na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa dharma saṃ ghe bh+yaḥ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bi pu la bi pu la gar+bhe/ bi pu la/ bi ma le/ bi pu la gar+bhe/ bi ma le/ dza ya gar+bhe/ badz+ra dz+wā lā gar+bhe/ ga ti ga ha ne ga ga na bi sho dha ne/ sarba pā pa bi sho dha ne/ oṃ gu ṇa ba ti/ ga ga na pi tsā ri ṇi/ ga ga ri ṇi/ gi gi gi ri/ gi ri ṇi gi ri ṇi/ ga ma ri ga ma ri/ ga ha ga ha/ garga ri garga ri/ ga ga ri/ ga ga ri/ gam+bha ri gam+bha ri/ ga bhi/ ga bhi/ ga hi ga hi/ ga ma ni ga ma ni/ ga ri ga ri/ gu bha gu bha/ gu ha gu ha/ gu ru gu ru/ gu ru ṇi/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsa le tsa le/ mu tse le/ mu tse le/ dza ye bi dza ye/ sarba bha ya/ bi ga te/ satwa sarba gar+bha saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi/ si ri si ri/ bhi ri bhi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ ghi ri ghi ri/ ghi ri ghi ri sam+nata par+ṣa ṇi/ bha ga wa tī/ satwā nā ya ki sa man+ta nā ya ki sarba sha trūṃ pra ma rda ni/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ/ sarba satwā ñca sarba dā/ sarba bha ye bh+yaḥ sarba u pa dra be bh+yaḥ sarba bya dhi bh+ya ñja/ tsi ri tsi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bi ga ta/ ā wa ra ṇe bi sho dha ne/ bi bi dha/ ā ba ra ṇa/ bi nā sha ni/ mu ri mu ri/

mu tsi mu tsi/ mu li mu li/ tsi li tsi li/ ki li ki li/ mi li mi li/ ka ma le/ bi ma le/ dza ye bi dza ye/ bi dza yā ba he/ dza ya wa ti/ bi she ṣa ba ti/ bha ga ba tī ma hā bi d+yā rat+na ma ku ṭa mā la dha ri/ bī hu bi bi dhā bi tsi tra bi shwa dha ri ṇi/ bha ga wa tī ma hā bi d+yā de wī/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sa pa ri wā ra/ sarba satwā ñca/ sa man+ta sarba tra/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ hu ru hu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba satwā ñca/ a nā tha/ na tra yā/ na sha ra ṇa/ na pa ra ya ṇa na/ pa ri mo tsa ya sarba duḥkhe bh+yaḥ tsaṇ+ḍe tsaṇ+ḍe/ tsaṇ+ḍe tsaṇ+ḍe/ tsaṇ+ḍi ṇi tsaṇ+ḍi ṇi/ be ga wa ti/ sarba duṣ+ṭā ni bā ra ṇi/ bi dza ya bā hi ni/ hu ru hu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tu ru tu ru/ a yuḥpa li ni/ su ra ba ra pra ma tha ni/ sarba de wa ga ṇa pū dzi te/ tsi ri tsi ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ sa man+ta a wa lo ki te/ pra bhe pra bhe/ su pra bhe/ su pra bha/ bi shud+dhe/ sarba pā pa bi shud+dhe/ sarba pā pa bi sho dha ne/ dhu ru dhu ru/ dha ra ṇi/ dha re dha re/ dha ra/ su mu su mu/ su mu su mu/ mu su mu su/ ru ru tsa le tsā la ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭhā nā shāsh+sha ra ṇa bha wa tu māṃ/ ā sha sū ra ya māṃ/ shrī wa su dha ri/ dza ya ka ma le/ k+ṣi ṇi k+ṣi ṇi/ ba ra da/ aṃ ku she oṃ pad+ma bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ maṃ ga la bi shud+dhe/ ba bi tra mu khi khaḍ+gi ni/ khaḍ+gi ni/ kha ra kha ra/ dz+wa li ta/ shi kha re/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki ta pra bhe/ su pra bi shud+dhe/ sa man+ta pra sā ri ta/ a bā bha si ta shud+dha/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ sarba de wa ga ṇa/ gra ha/ nak+ṣa tra/ sa ma ā kar+ṣa ṇi/ sat+ya pra ti oṃ hrī trāṃ tā ra tā ra/ tā ra ya tā ra ya māṃ/ bha ga wa tī sarba satwa sh+tsa/ na ga bya ba lo ki ti/ la hu la hu/ hu lu hu lu/ hu du hu du/ tu ru tu ru/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ k+ṣi ṇi k+ṣi ṇi/ hu ṇi hu ṇi/

sarba gra ha bak+ṣa ṇi/ piṃ ga la piṃ ga le/ mu tsu mu tsu/ tsu mu tsu mu/ su bi tsa re/ ta ra ta ra/ na ga bya ba lo ki ni/ tā ra ya māṃ/ sarba satwa ñca/ bha ga wa tī/ aṣ+ṭa ma hā tā ra ya bha ye bh+yaḥsarba tra sa man+ta sarba di sha ban+dhe na/ badz+ra prā kā ra/ badz+ra pā sha ban+dhe na tsa/ badz+ra dz+wā lā bi shud+dhe/ bhu ri bhu ri/ dha ra dha ra/ ti ri ti ri/ tu ru tu ru/ bha ga wa tī/ gar+bha bi shud+dha/ gar+bha saṃ sho dha ni/ ku k+ṣi/ saṃ pū ra ṇi/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ tsa la tsa la/ dz+wā li ni dz+wā li ni/ bar+ṣa tu de wa sa man+tā she ya u da ke ta/ a mṛ ta bar+ṣa ṇi de wa tā a ba tā ra ṇi/ a bhi ṣiñcan+tu maṃ/ su ga ta ba ra ba tsa na/ a mṛ ta ba ra pu ṣe/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bha ga wa tī māṃ/ sarba tra/ sarba dhā/ sarba bha ya bh+yaḥ sarba u pa dra be bh+yaḥ sarba u pa sar+ghe bh+yaḥ sarba bya dhi bh+yaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭā bh+yaḥ ya ba ti bh+yaḥ sarba ki li ki la ha/ bi gra ha bi bā dā/ dur+sap+na/ durni mit+ta/ a maṃ ga la/ pā pa bi sho dha ni/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa/ na ga pi dā ra ṇi/ ba la ba la/ ba la ba ti dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ dza ya tu māṃ/ sarba tā sarba kā le/ sidh+yan+tu me i yaṃ ma hā bid+yā/ sā dha ya maṇ+ḍa laṃ/ sā dha ya man+t+ran/ ghā ta ya bigh+nān/ dza ya dza ya/ sid+dh+yi sid+dh+yi/ sid+dh+ya sid+dh+ya/ bud+dh+ya bud+dh+ya/ su tsa ya sū tsa ya/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ pū ra ṇi pū ra ṇi/ pū ra ya me ā shān/ sarba bid+yā uṅga ta murti/ dza yo adhi/ dza ya ba ti ni/ tiṣ+ṭhatiṣ+ṭha bha ga wa tī/ sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ye shud+dhe/ bya ba lo ka ra ya māṃ sa pa ri wā raṃ sarba satwā sh+tsa aṣ+ṭa ma hā bha ye bh+yaḥ sarba ā shaṃ pa ri pū ra ya/ tra ya swā/ ma hā bha ye bh+yaḥ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sarba ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni/ sa man+ta ā ka ra maṇ+ḍal bi shud+dhe/ bi ga te bi ga t-i/ bi ga ta ma le/ sarba ma la bi sho dha ni/ k+ṣi ṇi k+ṣi ṇi/ sarba pā pa bi shud+dhe/ ma la bi ga ti/

dza ya ba ti/ te dzo te dzo ba ti/ badz+ra badz+ra ba ti swā hā/ trai lo kya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta mur+dha a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba bo dhi satwa a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba de wa tā a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya sid+dhe swā hā/ in+t+ra in+t+ra bya ba lo ki te swā hā/ brah+me brah+ma dhu ṣi te swā hā/ biṣ+ṇu na ma skri te swā hā/ ma he shwa ra ban+dha da pū dzi te ye swā hā/ badz+ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ba la bir+ya a dhiṣ+ṭhā te swā hā/ dhṛ ta rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā/ bi ru ṭa kā ya swā hā/ bi ru pak+ṣā ya swā hā/ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā/ tsa turma hā rā dzā na ma skri tā ya swā hā/ ya ma ye swā hā/ ya ma pū dzi ti na ma skri tā ya swā hā/ bā ru ṇā ya swā hā/ ma ru tā ya swā hā/ ma hā ma ru tā ya swā hā/ ag+na ye swā hā/ nā ga bya ba lo ki te ye swā hā/ de wa ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ nā ga ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ yak+ṣa ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ ya ma ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ rāk+ṣa sa ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ gan+dharba ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ a su ra ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ ga ru ḍa ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ kan+ni ra ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ ma ho ra ga ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ ma nuṣ+ye ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ a ma nuṣ+ya ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba gra he bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba bhū te bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba pre te bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba pi shā tse bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba un+mā de bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba a pa smā re bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba kum+bhaṇ+ḍe bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba pū ta ne bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba ka ṭa pū ṭa ni bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba duṣ+ṭa pra duṣ+ṭe bh+yaḥswā hā/ oṃ dhu ru dhu ru swā hā/ oṃ tu ru tu ru swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/ oṃ mu ru mu ru swā hā/ oṃ ha na ha na sarba sha trūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ swā hā/

oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pra t+yā rti kā/ pra t+yaṃ mi trā nāṃ swā hā/ ye ma ma a hā ti ā she na te ṣāṃ sarba sha rī raṃ dz+wā la ya dz+wā la ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ tsit+tā nāṃ swā hā/ dz+wā li ta ye swā hā/ pra dz+wā li tā ya swā hā/ badz+ra dz+wā lā ya swā hā/ ag+ni dz+wā lā ya swā hā/ sa man+ta dz+wā lā ya swā hā/ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ pūr+ṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ ma hā kā lā swā hā/ ma tri ga ṇā ya swā hā/ yak+ṣa ṇi naṃ swā hā/ rāk+ṣa si ni naṃ swā hā/ ā kā sha ma tṛ ṇaṃ swā hā/ sa mu dra ba si naṃ swā hā/ ra tṛ tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ dī ba tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ tri san+dha tsa rā nāṃ swā hā/ be la tsa rā nāṃ swā hā/ a be la tsa rā nāṃ swā hā/ gar+bha ha re bh+yaḥswā hā/ gar+bhaya hi ri ṇi bh+yaḥswā hā/ hu lu hu lu swā hā/ oṃ swā hā/ swaḥswā hā/ bhuḥswā hā/ bhuḥwa swā hā/ oṃ bhur+bhu waḥswā hā/ bi li bi li swā hā/ tsi ṭi tsi ṭi swā hā/ bi ṭi bi ṭi swā hā/ dhā ra ṇi swā hā/ dhā ra ṇi swā hā/ ag+ni swā hā/ te dzo wa yu swā hā/ tsi li tsi li swā hā/ mi li mi li swā hā/ si li si li swā hā/ bud+dh+ya bud+dh+ya swā hā/ sid+dh+ya sid+dh+ya swā hā/ maṇ+ḍa la ban+dhe swā hā/ sī mā ban+dhe swā hā/ dhā ra ṇi ban+dhe swā hā/ sarba sha trūṃ/ bhañja ya bhañja ya swā hā/ dzam+bha ya dzam+bha ya swā hā/ stam+bha ya stam+bha ya swā hā/ tshin+da tshin+da swā hā/ bhin+da bhin+da swā hā/ bhañja bhañja swā hā/ ban+dha ban+dha swā hā/ mo ha ya mo ha ya swā hā/ ma ṇi bi shud+dhe swā hā/ sūr+ye swā hā/ sūr+ya bi shud+dhe swā hā/ sho dha ni swā hā/ bi sho dha ni swā hā/ tsan+d+re tsan+d+re pa ri pur+ṇa tsan+d+re swā hā/ gra he bh+yaḥswā hā/ nak+ṣa tre bh+yaḥswā hā/ pi shā tsi bh+yaḥswā hā/ shi phi bh+yaḥswā hā/ bi shwa bh+yaḥswā hā/ shān+ti bh+yaḥswā hā/ puṣ+ṭiṃ bh+yaḥswā hā/ swa sti ya ne bh+yaḥswā hā/

garba dha re swā hā/ shi pam̐ ka ri swā hā/ sham̐ ka ri swā hā/ shān+tiṃ ka ri swā hā/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ka ri swā hā/ ba la bar+dha ne swā hā/ ba la bar+dhi ni ka ri swā hā/ shrī ka ri swā hā/ shrī bar+dhi ni swā hā/ shrī dz+wā li ni swā hā/ mu tsi swā hā/ na mu tsi swā hā/ mu ru tsi swā hā/ be ga ba ti swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga te mūrti ba ra bi ma le bha ga wa ti/ swa ti bha wa tu/ ma ma sarba satwā ñca swā hā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni/ bi mu ni bi mu ni/ dha ri tsa la tsa la ni/ bha ga wa ti/ bha ya bi ga te/ bha ya ha ri ṇi/ bo dhi bo dhi/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bud+dhi li bud+dhi li/ tsum+bu li tsum+bu li swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya dzuṣ+ṭe swā hā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni/ mu ni ba re/ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ sarba satwa sh+tsa sarba ta thā ga ta/ sarba bid+yā a bhi ṣe kairma hā badz+ra ka tsa/ mu dre te/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ a dhiṣ+ṭhā na/ a dhiṣ+ṭhi te badz+re swā hā/ dbang bskur ba ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //tad+ya thā/ oṃ gi ri gi ri/ gi ri ṇi gi ri ṇi/ gi ri ba ti/ gu ṇa ba ti/ ā kā sha ba ti/ ā kā sha bi shud+dhe/ sarba pā pa bi ga te/ ā kā sha ga ga na ta le/ ā kā sha bi tsā ri ṇi/ dz+wā lī ta shi kha ra/ ma ṇi muk+ti ka kha tsi ta mau li dha re/ su ke she me ke she su ṣa su bka tre/ su ne tre su bar+ṇe/ su bar+ṇa gau ri/ a tī te/ a nut+pan+ne/ a nā ga te/ pra t+yut+pan+nen maḥsarbe ṣān/ bud+dha nān/ dz+wa li ta te dza sā na/ bud+dhe su bud+dhe/ bha ga wa ti/ su rak+ṣa ni suk+ṣe me/ su pra bhe/ su da me/ su dān+ti/ ba re ba re warte/ bha ga wa ti/ bha dra ba ti/ bha dre/ su bha dre/ bi ma le/ dza ya bha dre/ pra tsaṇ+ḍi tsaṇ+ḍi/ pra tsaṇ+ḍe/ pra tsaṇ+ḍe/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍe/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍe/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍe/ gau ri/ tsau ri/ tsaṇ+ḍā lī/ mā tāṃ gi brtsa si/ puk+ka si/ su ma ti/ sha ba ri/ shā ba ri/ shaṃ ka ri/ dra mi ḍi/ drā mi ḍi/ rau tri ni/

sarba gra ha bi dā ri ṇi ar+tha sā dha ni/ ha na ha na/ sarba sha trūṃ/ da ha da ha/ sarba dūṣ+ṭān/ pre ta pi shā tsa/ ḍā ki nī nāṃ/ ma nuṣ+yā/ a ma nuṣ+yā nāñca/ pa tsa pa tsa hṛ da ya na/ gdon ma rungs pa rnams kyi srog gzhom du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag gi sdig pa thams cad gzhig tu gsol/ gzhig tu gsol/ thams cad du 'jigs pa dang*/ gnod pa thams cad las bdag la bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol/ ma rungs pa thams cad bcing du gsol/ sarba kilpi ṣa nā sha ni/ mārta ṇ+ḍa/ mṛ t+yū daṇ+ḍa ni bā ra ṇi/ mā na na/ daṇ+ḍa mā na ni/ ma hā mā ni ni/ ma hā bi ṇi ṭi/ tsa le tsa le/ tsi ṭi tsi ṭi/ bi ṭi bi ṭi/ ni ṭi ni ṭi/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ na tu ṭi/ gau ri ṇi/ bī ri ṇi/ pra ba ra sa ma re/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ mā tāṃ gi run+dha si/ sa ra si/ brtsa si/ su ma ti/ puk+ka si/ sha ba ri/ shā ba ri/ sham̐ ka ri/ dra mi ḍi/ drā mi ḍi/ da ha ni/ pa tsa ni/ ma tha ni/ marda ni/ sa ra li/ sa ra le/ sa ra laṃ bhe/ hī na ma dh+yoṅkiraṣ+ṭa/ bi dhā ra ṇi/ bi dhā ri ṇi/ ma hi le/ ma hā ma hi le/ ni ga ḍe/ ṇi ga ḍe/ bhañje/ mat+ti mat+ti ni/ dān+ti tsakre/ tsakra bā gi ni/ dz+wa le dz+wa le/ dz+wā le dz+wā le/ dz+wā la ni/ sha ba ri sha ba ri/ shā ba ri shā ba ri/ sarba byā dhi/ ha ra ṇi/ tsū ḍi tsū ḍi/ tsū ḍi ni tsū ḍi ni/ ma hā tsū ḍi ni/ ni mi ni mi/ ni min+dha ri/ tri lo ka da ha ni/ tri lo ka ā lo ka kā ri/ trai dhā tu ka bya ba lo ki ni/ badz+ra pa ra shu/ pā sha mut+ka ra/ khaḍ+ga/ shaṅkha/ tsakra/ tri shū la/ tsin+tā ma ṇi/ ma hā bid+yā dhā ra ṇi/ bdag thams cad du gnas thams cad du gnas pa na ma rungs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ nad thams cad dang*/ 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung su gsol/ bsrung du gsol lo// badz+re badz+re badz+ra ba ti/ badz+ra pā ṇi dha re/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ ki li ki li/ tsi li tsi li/ pi li pi li/

si li si li/ ba ra ba ra ba ra de/ sarba tra/ dza ya lab+dhe swā hā/ sarba pā pa bi dā ri ṇi swā hā/ sarba tra sarba byā dhi ha ra ṇi swā hā/ sarba tra sarba sha trūn bha ya ha ra ṇi swā hā/ sarba bha ra ṇi swā hā/ swa stir+bha ba tu māṃ swā hā/ shān+tiṃ ka ri swā hā/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ka ri swā hā/ ba la bar+dha ri ṇi swā hā/ dza ya tu/ dza ye dza ye/ dza ya ba ti/ ka ma le/ bi ma le/ bi pu le swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta mūrti swā hā/ oṃ bhu ri ma hā shān+ti swā hā/ oṃ bhū ri bhū ri badz+ra ba ti/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya pū ra ṇi/ ā yus+san+dhā ra ṇi/ ba la ba la ba la ba ti/ dza ya bi dzi ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dbang bskur ba'i gzungs phyi ma ste bcu gsum pa'o// //bden pa dang bden pa'i mchog gang gis/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas pa'i tshig bden pa rnams dang 'jig rten gyi tshig gi mchog dang*/ dge sbyong rnams kyi nang na dge sbyong skyid de ba zhes bya ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'jigs pa mi mnga' ba/ bag tsha ba mi mnga' ba ste/ mi skrag mi 'bros la 'jigs pa med cing*/ 'jigs pa dang*/ 'jigs par byed pa spangs pa/ skyi bung zhes byed pa med pa'o zhes yang dag par smra bas smra ba ni/ dus su yang dag par smra bas smra ba yin te/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis tshul khrims dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ dka' thub dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa gang ci yang rung ba de dag gi nang na ni/ 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig gnas brtan rgyal po'i bu thu bo dang 'dra ba rab tu byung nas ring du lon pa tshangs par spyod pa mngon par spyad pa rnams kyi mchog 'di lta ste/

dge slong kun shes kau ḍi n+ya dang*/ 'dod pa nyung ba dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa dang*/ cho ga shes pa rnams kyi mchog 'od srungs chen po dang*/ shes rab che ba dang*/ spobs pa che ba rnams kyi mchog sha ra dwa ti'i bu dang*/ rdzu 'phrul che ba dang*/ mthu che ba rnams yi mchog maung gal gyi bu chen po dang*/ lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog ma 'gags pa dang*/ mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog kun dga' bo dang*/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog nye ba 'khor dang*/ chos smra ba rnams kyi mchog byams ma'i bu gang po dang*/ bslab pa la gus pa rnams kyi mchog sgra gcan 'dzin dang*/ mal cha dang stan bsko ba rnams kyi mchog gyad bu nor dang*/ seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa rnams kyi mchog bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len dang*/ khyim pa dad pa bskyed pa rnams kyi mchog nag po chen po 'char ka dang*/ lha dang mis mchod pa rnams kyi mchog legs mthong gi bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o// rgyal po'am/ chom rkun nam/ me'am/ chu'am/ dgra'am/ mi mdza' ba'am/ lam du 'gro ba'am/ lam gol bar 'gro ba'am/ gnyid log pa'am/ ra ro ba'am/ bag med pa thams cad las bsrung bar bya'o// bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis sems can rkang pa med pa'am/ rkang gnyis pa'am/ rkang bzhi pa'am/ rkang mangs sam/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes can nam/ 'du shes med pa'am/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi sems can ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o// bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis 'dus byas sam/

'dus ma byas kyi chos ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ 'dod chags dang bral ba mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o// bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ tshogs sam/ 'dus pa'am/ mang po'am/ 'khor ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des/ rgyal khams sam/ yul 'khor ram/ grong ngam/ grong rdal lam/ grong khyer ram/ khyim mam/ nags sam/ zhing ngam/ nad pa 'di la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ mtshams gcad par bya'o// 'byung po thams cad bzlog par bya'o// gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bya'o// bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngas/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug zad par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ brjod pa'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zad par gyur cig med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ bden pa'i stobs kyis bsrung ba ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //nad pa'i zas dang*/ skom dang*/ sman rnams kyang rig sngags 'dis btab ste stsal bar bgyi'o// rdzogs sangs rgyas rnam par sangs rgyas tshe// 'jig rten skyong bas phyogs bzhi nas// snod bzhi dag ni blangs nas su// bde bar gshegs la phul ba dang*// mthu yis gcig tu sprul mdzad pa// lha yi snod mchog de dang ni// bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams// ston pa'i phyag na bsnams gyur pa// bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog

/de bzhin lha mo 'phrog ma yis// lha rdzas dge ba a ru ra// blangs nas ston la rab phul ba// bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams// bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis// nad pa rnams kyi nad sel cing*// nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang*// gtsug tor can gyi stobs rnams dang*// thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang*// log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang*// gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang*// 'od srungs kyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang*// shākya seng ge'i mthu rnams kyis// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /nad pa shar phyogs kha bstan la// sman rnams nye bar stsal bar bgyi// de yi tshe na rig sngags 'di// lag mthil gzhag ste klag par bgyi// s+yād+ya the dan/ kha ṭe kha ṭe/ kha ṭe bi kha ṭe/ bi ma le/ bi laṃ be/ ba le/ ba la ba ti/ tsan+d+re/ tsa ra ṇe/ a mṛ ta nir+gho ṣe swā hā/ rlung las gyur dang mkhris las gyur// bad kan las gyur 'dus las gyur// nad rnams thams cad rab bcom ste// bdag la rtag tu bde legs shog /bram ze rnams kyis bslus nas su// shākya seng ge skyob pa la// dpal sbas kyis ni dug can gyi// bsod snyoms dag ni phul ba dang*// de las de ni blangs nas su// ston pas dug ni bsad nas gsol// bden pa'i tshig ni 'di yis su// zas ni bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /rnam par gzigs la lha gang dang*// gtsug tor can dang kun skyob dang*// log par dad pa sel ba dang*// stobs chen lha gang dad pa dang*// gser dang dpal ldan 'od srungs dang*// shākya yi ni seng ge la// rab dad lha yi dbang po dang*// tshangs dbang sum cu'i dbang phyug dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dag dang*// nor bu bzang dang dbang phyug che// srin mo nag mo chen mo dang*// de bzhin gdol ma gtum mo dag /me tog dang ni bdug pa dang*// bdag gi sbyin sreg 'di bzhes shig

/de dag tshim zhing mchod gyur nas// bdag gi kha zas byang bar mdzod// zas lnga dag dang 'dres pa yang*// bdag la ma 'dres mdzad du gsol// kha zas lnga dang 'dres pa yang*// zas de kun ni bza' bar bgyi// sa bon dag gi tshogs kun la// sa yi bcud ni zhugs pa yi// kha zas 'dres pa thams cad kyang*// bdag la ma 'dres mdzad du gsol// ji ltar skud pa bcad bsregs kyang*// de lta bur yang slar 'byor pa// de ltar zas rnams 'dres pa yang*// ma 'dres pari na bdag la mdzod// s+yād+ya the dan/ kha kha me/ kha kha/ kha kha/ kha kha me/ shi me/ shi me/ shi hū me/ shi ma/ shi me swa sti swa sti/ swa sti swa sti ma ma shin+taṃ/ shā rā gri/ kha zas lnga dang 'dres pa yang*// ji ltar ma 'dres zas bzhin du// gang gis ji ltar skud bsregs pa// de 'dra'i bden pa mdzad du gsol// s+yād+ya the dan/ ka la ke ka la le/ pa la ni/ ka ru ta ā la ye/ ag+ne/ sam̐ krā ma ṇe swā hā/ sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs dang sangs rgyas gtsug tor can// bde gshegs kun skyob sangs rgyas log par dad sel dang*// gser thub 'od srungs shākya thub pa gau ta mya// bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba la skyabs su mchi bar bgyi// mi mchog bdun po de dag gi ni sku rnams la// me tog dag dang spos rnams kyis ni mchod par bgyi// lus dang ngag dang rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis ni// de dag rnams la skyabs su nye bar mchi bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che dang ldan pa de dag la// lha gang mngon par rab tu dang ba yod pa yi// lha de mgu zhing yid ni rab tu dga' 'gyur nas// rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag la bsrung du gsol// //'jig rten 'di'am yang na 'das pa dang*// mtho ris dag na rin chen mchog yod pa'ang*// de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi lhar gyur pa// mi yi mchog dang 'dir ni mtshungs pa med// de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog

/zad pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas// shes pas shākya thub de rab tu phye// bdud rtsi zhi ba 'dus byas ma yin pa// chos de dang ni mtshungs pa gang yang med// de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /mchog tu gang 'dod tshul bzhin rab bstan pa// ston pa'i rnal 'byor bla med rtag bsgrub pa// rdo rje lta bu mi gnyis lam mthong ba// ting 'dzin de dang mnyam pa yod ma yin// de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde logs shog /gang zag chen po brgyad po rab bsngags shing*// gang zag zung bzhir brjod pa de dag ni// drang srong chen po gang zag mtshungs med pa// bde bar gshegs pas sbyin pa'i gnas shes gsungs// de la byin na 'bras bu cher 'gyur te// zhing rab gshin la sa bon btab pa bzhin// 'di ni dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /gang dag brtan pa'i yid kyis rab brtson zhing*// gau ta ma yi bstan la 'jug byed pa// de dag thob nas bdud rtsi 'jug thob ste// mun pa bsal nas mya ngan 'das thob pa// de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /lta ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni// 'jig tshogs lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang*// the tshom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /cig char spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni mchog thob shog /lus sam ngag gam 'on te yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa rnam gsum nam yang mi byed la// glo bur byas na'ang 'chab par mi byed cing*// de ltar de dag lta bas 'dzin mi byed// de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /ji ltar dbang po'i sdong po sar btsugs pa// phyogs bzhi'i rlung rnams kyis ni mi g.yo ltar// 'phags pa'i lam gyi dam pa mthong ba yi// gang zag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun de bzhin no// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog

/shes rab zab mos shin tu bstan pa yi// 'phags pa'i bden pa su dag rnam bsgom zhing*// lus kyang sbyin par yid la byas pa ni// de dag 'jigs pa brgyad dang 'phrad mi 'gyur// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /ji ltar me ni rlung gis rab gtor ba// lag tu blangs te bgrang du med pa nyid// de ltar kun tu sbyor ba rab btang ba// sangs rgyas sras rnams bstan du med par 'gro// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bder gyur cig /ston mchog lha dang mis ni mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bder gyur cig /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te// sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod gyur cig /'di ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis// shin tu bden pa gsung zhing brdzun med pa// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig swā hā// //shis pa brjod pa ste bco lnga pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
